task:
Retire V2-era API routes that cannot work on V3 (2026-10-26 repository sweep S3; Colony Planner design S7).

apps/api/src/main.py still mounts V2-era routers (notes, profile-sync, events, optimiser, simulate, the anonymous V2 journal and exploration imports, legacy watchlist and others) that read or write tables no sql/v3 or sql/r1_v3 migration creates, for example system_notes, profile_sync, eddn_log, facility_templates, system_archetype_scores, journal_import_staging and exploration_facts. On the V3 production database those calls fail with 500s.

Do this:
1. Inventory every mounted router and route in apps/api/src/main.py. For each, list the tables it reads/writes and check them against the CREATE statements in sql/v3/**, sql/r1_v3/** and the current migration ledger docs. Also list its callers in apps/web/src (generated SDK usage in apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts and features). Commit this inventory as docs/development/v3-v2-route-retirement.md (table: route, tables, exists on V3?, web callers, action).
2. For every route whose tables do not exist on V3 AND that apps/web does not call: keep the path but answer 410 Gone with a small JSON body {"detail": "This V2 endpoint is not available on V3.", "replacement": <V3 path or null>} via one shared dependency/handler, without touching the database. Do not delete V3-backed routes, the V3 planner (/api/v1/plan/*), the V3 watchlist, auth/identity, the V3 journal import, ratings V4, archetypes, Finder search, map, share (/s/{id64}) or health. If apps/web still calls a V2 route that cannot work, stop and list it in the inventory as "needs owner decision" instead of retiring it.
3. Mark retired operations deprecated in OpenAPI, regenerate the generated clients (apps/web/src/lib/api/generated/*, packages/api-client/src/generated/api.gen.ts) with the existing openapi-types tooling, and make sure pnpm check passes.
4. Tests: one parametrized test that every retired route returns 410 with the body and performs no database access (use a pool double that fails if touched), plus a static test that the retired list matches the inventory document. Keep existing tests passing; update any that asserted the old V2 behaviour.
5. CHANGES.md entry. Run the full Python unit suite and pnpm check/test/build in apps/web.
